newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $22.55 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $22.55 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius sold all 450.0 million rupees ($22.55 million) of treasury bills it tendered at its weekly auction, the bank said on Thursday.

The central bank said it sold 92.0 million rupees of 91-day, 253.0 million rupees of 182-day and 105.0 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.57 percent, 9.58 percent and 9.87 percent respectively.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 9.90 percent per annum from 9.83 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the Bank of Mauritius sold 297.1 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.48 percent, 9.58 percent and 9.84 percent respectively.
